name: Tata Power Company Ltd
title: Tata Power Company Ltd - 500400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Tata Power FY26 capex came in well below the earlier ~INR22,000-25,000 crore guide, with FY27 reset to about INR25,000 crore on a 2.5 GW commissioning plan, while Mundra SPPA settles and Odisha loss reduction runs.

triggers.label: FY26 capex short of guide
triggers.quote: We have fallen short because some of the projects that we were planning to execute in the last quarter could not happen.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR25,000 cr
triggers.quote: It's about INR25,000 crores. That is what we are expecting.

triggers.label: Solar deferred until GNA secured
triggers.quote: some of our capex, which we had planned last year got deferred because we do not want to set up the plant and be on temporary GNA

triggers.label: Power demand up 5-6% since April
triggers.quote: we are now seeing from April onwards that the demand has gone up by 5% to 6%
